Okra

Connecting a data product’s promise to measurable behavior.

Role
Manager, Strategy & Product
Period
2021–2024
Focus
Classification & integration reliability

The product challenge

At Okra, I conceived and launched an ML-powered Income API. The product needed to classify income using transaction patterns and employer signals. Making that useful required translating a product requirement into classification behavior and evaluation criteria.

The question was how to define the expected output clearly enough that product and engineering could evaluate it together.

My contribution

I defined income-classification logic and worked with engineering to set precision and recall thresholds. Precision measures how often a positive prediction is correct. Recall measures how many actual positives the system identifies. Each describes a different part of the system’s behavior.

My responsibility was product definition and engineering collaboration, including the classification logic and evaluation thresholds. That connected the intended use of the product with explicit criteria for reviewing its output.

Making evaluation part of product work

A classification result needs a precise definition before it can guide a product decision. Precision, recall, and overall accuracy answer different questions. This project gave me a concrete setting for working with engineering on those distinctions and on the behavior the API needed to deliver.

Related work on reliability

For Okra Direct, I addressed screen-scraped connections that had become a reliability bottleneck. I ranked banks by connection volume to prioritize direct API integrations and coordinated the work through partnerships.

This used observed connection demand to determine where integration work should begin. The Income API and Okra Direct show two connected aspects of data-product delivery: defining what an output should mean, and improving the reliability of the connections supporting it.

Two product questions

Is the output useful?

Classification logic, precision, recall, and explicit evaluation criteria.

Is the connection reliable?

Integration priorities informed by connection volume and coordinated through partnerships.
